sources.title: MuScriptor: An Open Model for Multi-Instrument Music Transcription
sources.snippet: We further introduce conditioning on instrument presence to customize transcriptions. Finally, we release MuScriptor, an open-weight multi-instrument music transcription model that works on real-world music recordings from across a diverse range of musical genres.

sources.title: MuScriptor: Audio to MIDI Converter
sources.snippet: What is MuScriptor? › MuScriptor is an audio to MIDI converter: you give it a recording and it transcribes the notes played by every instrument into MIDI. It was developed by Kyutai and Mirelo. Is it free to use? › Yes. This demo is free, the code is MIT-licensed, and the model weights are published on HuggingFace under CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial use). If you want to run it locally ...
